summary: Farheen presented ATLAS SkillTech University's BKC-Mumbai campus to TOC counselors, describing its four schools -- ISDI (design, in collaboration with Parsons), ISME (management, part of the Babson group of roughly 30 schools worldwide), uGDX (technology), and a Bar Council-approved School of Law -- along with student achievements at competitions run by NASA and Google, and on-campus housing via upGrad Living.
keyInsights: ISDI (design school) runs in collaboration with Parsons School of Design.
ISME (management school) is part of the Babson group, roughly 30 schools worldwide.
Students have won accolades at NASA- and Google-run competitions.
